verdict.rationale: The official README states Solid is 'naturally debuggable' because 'a <div> is a real div, so you can use your browser's devtools to inspect the rendering' (solid-gh-12, solid-gh-5). It also describes direct DOM access with minimal abstractions (solid-gh-8). A hands-on user confirms that refs are just the real elements (solid-comm-4), and another reports state changes are easy to debug (solid-comm-10). The complaint about alpha dev tools (solid-comm-15) concerns Solid's own devtools extension, not inspecting real DOM in browser devtools, so it does not contradict the story. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the browser-devtools debugging workflow (the evidence is mostly a repeated README tagline), and direct independent hands-on reports of inspecting Solid output in browser devtools.
